title: Add generated sales-friendly RBAC capabilities summary (roles/permissions)
author: Hanae Suzuki
body: Context: Sales/SE keep getting RBAC questions in RFPs (“Do you support least privilege? What roles exist? Are API keys scoped? Is SSO required?”). Our existing policy bundle is accurate but not readable for non-technical reviewers and is hard to cite consistently. This PR adds a generated, sales-friendly RBAC capabilities summary that is intended to be referenced by the RFP response library and SE copy/paste blocks. Scope/Non-goals: This is documentation generated from the source-of-truth policy definitions; it does not change enforcement behavior. It also does not introduce new roles/permissions, and it must not imply roadmap items. What changed: (1) Added a generator script that reads the policy bundle (roles + permission grants) and emits a stable Markdown summary under docs/ with an explicit “Last generated” timestamp and a version pin to the bundle commit. (2) Standardized role naming + descriptions for customer-facing consumption (e.g., “Organization Admin” instead of internal shorthand) while keeping canonical identifiers in a reference table. (3) Added a “Coverage” section that calls out where permissions apply (Console vs API) and the current limitations we see in questionnaires (e.g., some org settings are console-only). (4) Added an “Approved wording” callout block that SE/Sales can quote verbatim (non-contractual; subject to deployment mode and customer configuration). (5) Added CI to ensure the generated file is up-to-date (fails if generator output differs from committed docs). Output artifact: docs/rbac-capabilities-summary.md. Example excerpt included in the generated doc: Roles: Organization Admin (full org management; can manage users/SSO settings/API keys), Billing Admin (billing + invoices only; no model access), Developer (manage API keys + view usage; cannot modify SSO), Read-only Auditor (view-only access to org settings + audit log exports; cannot create keys). Permission families summarized: identity & access (users/teams/SSO/SCIM), inference access (keys, endpoints), observability (usage, logs), governance (policy exports), billing (invoices, plan). Testing: ran `make gen` and `make lint`; validated generator determinism by running twice; verified CI check fails if docs are edited by hand. Rollout/Consumers: This file is referenced by the Security Enablement Kit (RFP library + SSO/RBAC standard answers). Reminder: use this as “capabilities summary” language and route contractual commitments through Legal/Security. Screenshots: N/A (docs-only).

Hanae Suzuki (2026-02-01): Added an ‘Approved wording’ callout with exact text; kept it deployment-agnostic and pointed to SSO/SCIM doc for identity integrations.
Naomi Feldman (2026-02-02): Ensure role names match Console UI and don’t conflict with planned consolidation work. Also please make the generator deterministic so diffs are stable.
Hanae Suzuki (2026-02-02): Synced role display names with current Console labels; generator now sorts roles and permission families; added snapshot test to enforce stability.
Daniel Carter (2026-02-03): Can we include an explicit line about evidence: “we can provide RBAC documentation under NDA” and keep it consistent with GRC language?
Hanae Suzuki (2026-02-03): Added a final section ‘Evidence and documentation’ pointing to the standard evidence request process (no links to restricted storage).
Kevin Osei (2026-02-04): Approved with the updated disclaimer + CI guardrail. Please avoid manual edits to generated doc going forward.
Markus Klein (2026-02-04): Approved. I’ll point the RFP library snippet to this file once it lands.
